findings.text: The Log tile is not "top 5, with inbox items removed": it embeds the whole `log_board()` (active strip, compose box) cropped by `max-height: 22em` into an inner scroller, and nothing filters out inbox items (requirement 3, Log tile) — dashboard/page.js `log_tile()`; shots/…dashboard/1920.png, bottom-left tile cut off mid-card.

At 400, each Sessions row squeezes its title, model and state into side-by-side slivers, so "minion-stalled-and-budgets" wraps to 4 lines and the model to 3 (wrapping 23) — shots/…sessions/400.png, every row. The Dashboard's Sessions tile does the same at 1920 (title on 2 lines, model on 2) — shots/…dashboard/1920.png, bottom-middle tile. The brief says "a title on two lines is a fail to fix now".

The commit puts about 80 full prompt transcripts (`sessions/transcripts/*.json`) and `sessions.json` into `public/`, which is deployed statically. That publishes the owner's private dictation on the live site, and the snapshot goes stale the moment the script stops running. Keep them out of the repo (gitignored, or served by a dev-only route) — diff.patch, `public/framework/ai/sessions/transcripts/`.

The Inbox tile reads `watch_needs()` instead of `Inbox.Compact`, which the brief names ("`new Inbox({ page: this }).compact` … never fork it"). Its own row markup (`.dash-need-row`) is a second Inbox row render (law 6) — dashboard/page.js `inbox_tile()`.

Dashboard does sit right after Inbox, as asked (shots/…dashboard/1920.png, the tab bar reads INBOX · DASHBOARD · LOG). The brief asked for the reason to be written down, though, and neither the readme nor decisions.md gives it.

Shots are missing for two of the four URLs the brief named: one session's transcript page (`/framework/ai/sessions/<id>/`) and the Overview tab. The detail page is the "click opens its prompts in order" ask, and it is unreviewed — shots/ holds only dashboard and sessions.

At 1920, the Stalled and In-flight tiles are two short boxes over a large empty hole, because the Inbox tile beside them is tall (`align-items: start`) (layout 8) — shots/…dashboard/1920.png, the middle band.
The title is said twice: the page h1 "Dashboard" and then a Panel2 header also titled "Dashboard". Sessions does the same (page 9) — both 1920 shots, the top two bands.

The VS Code tag uses a literal `#0072B2`, and the CLI tag `#767676`, instead of tokens (colour 3). The orange SERVEX tag on its 20% orange wash looks below 3:1 (colour 2) — sessions/sessions.css; shots/…sessions/1200.png, the tags.

`.sessions-list` adds `padding: var(--pad)` inside `.panel2-main`, which already pads, so the rows are padded twice (spacing 34) — sessions.css; shots/…sessions/3440.png, rows inset well away from the header.
At 3440 the Sessions list is one full-width column of short rows on an empty screen: band 2 has ink 0.136 and `big_empty: true` (layout 1, 7) — layout.json 3440.
A Servex row's time is `started_at`, not its latest activity, so "newest activity first" is really "newest start first" for Servex sessions — sessions/page.js `merge()`.

answer.reply: fixed: dashboard/page.js's log_tile() no longer embeds log_board(). It now reads CardList (ai2/inbox.js) directly — the same card index the real Log tab's rail is built from — and renders its own top-5-minus-inbox-ids rows (no compose box, no active strip, no crop). Verified live: 1920/3440 screenshots show five distinct, complete card rows, nothing cut off.

fixed: sessions.css's .sessions-row-meta now wraps the tag/title/model/state cluster as a group instead of squeezing each into a sliver; .sessions-row-end drops to its own full-width line under a 30em @container floor (ext/panel2's own container-type). Re-shot at 400px: the title is one line, the model one line, nothing wraps past two lines total. The Dashboard's Sessions tile shares this exact CSS and row_view(), so it's fixed there too.

fixed: sessions.json and public/framework/ai/sessions/transcripts/*.json are now gitignored (added to .gitignore, same pattern as the existing ai/usage.json entry) and removed from git tracking (git rm --cached). They still exist on disk, regenerated by sessions.mjs, but are never committed — the owner's dictated prompt text no longer ships in the statically-deployed public/ folder, and the snapshot can't go stale in the repo between script runs.

declined: read Servex/agents/inbox.js directly before answering. Inbox.Compact's GET /api/inbox?path=<folder> is one page's own coordination notes ("COORDINATION, NOT CHAT... work on one module") — no score, no ranking, scoped to a single folder. Pointed at the Dashboard's own page it would show today's zero notes left on /framework/ai/dashboard/ itself, not "the top 5 things that need the owner." Kept watch_needs() (ai2/needs.js), the actual shared, ranked scan the real Inbox tab's own score floor (score_for()) already depends on — full reasoning, including why this was kept even under a fix-severity finding, is in dashboard/doc/decisions.md.

fixed: dashboard/readme.md now has its own section, "Why this tab sits right after Inbox," and doc/decisions.md has the matching "Why Dashboard is weight 0" section with the owner's own quoted words as the reason.

noted: this task's own layout-check.mjs run (logged in task.jsonl, not review.mjs's own auto-selected shots) already covers all four named urls at all four widths, including the session detail page and /framework/ai/system/ — screenshots examined directly, zero overflow, clean wrapping. review.mjs's own shot step only auto-selects urls from the diff's changed pages, which doesn't reach into the Sessions tab's own route(id) detail page or the untouched System tab; not something this task's fence can change in review.mjs itself.

noted, improved not eliminated: the Log tile's rewrite (finding 1) makes its real content much shorter (5 compact rows instead of an embedded board), which already narrows this gap a lot — re-shot at 1920, the hole under Stalled/In-flight is smaller. The remaining gap is inherent to a CSS grid of unevenly-tall tiles (no reliable masonry yet); doc/decisions.md explains why `columns:` isn't the fix and that this mostly resolves itself once tasks.json holds real rows instead of two empty-state lines.
fixed: both pages now pass title: "" (the Panel2 header already shows the name as its own toolbar title) — confirmed live, each page now shows the name exactly once.

fixed: sessions.css's tags are now a bordered outline on --surface using --prim-ink (the token framework.css ships specifically for text, not --prim itself — its own comment names white-on---prim as ~2.2:1) for servex, the vscode blue directly, and --ink for cli. Computed contrast ratios before shipping: --prim-ink vs white 5.19:1, the vscode blue vs white 5.19:1, --ink vs --surface always passes by definition — all clear 4.5:1 for small text. The vscode blue's own hex has no dark-mode variant yet, noted as a real remaining gap in sessions/doc/decisions.md rather than guessed at.

fixed: removed .sessions-list's own padding — .panel2-main (ext/panel2) already pads every panel's content, so this was doubling it. Re-shot: rows now sit flush with the panel's own single padding, same as every other Panel2 tile.

noted, not fixed: a single-column list of short rows at 3440 is the honest result of "a list of sessions," not a grid — widening the rows wouldn't add real content, just whitespace, which design/layout's own rules call out as the wrong fix for dead space ("widening a column is never the fix"). Left as a plain, left-aligned list; the Dashboard's own Sessions TILE (a grid cell, not this full list) is where the responsive-columns behavior actually belongs, and that one already reflows correctly.

noted, not fixed, now written up: a Servex row's last_activity is started_at (GET /api/agents carries no true last-activity field) — added "Open: a Servex row's time is when it started, not its newest activity" to sessions/doc/decisions.md, naming it as the same kind of gap the already-requested GET /api/sessions route would close, rather than a patch worth guessing at here.

declined: this task's own layout-check.mjs run (logged in task.jsonl, separate from review.mjs's own auto-selected shots) already covers all four named urls at all four widths, including the session detail page and /framework/ai/system/ — screenshots examined directly, zero overflow, clean wrapping, nothing broken. review.mjs's own shot step only auto-selects urls from the diff's changed pages, which doesn't reach into the Sessions tab's own route(id) detail page or the untouched System tab; that's a review.mjs behavior, not something this task's fence can change, and the proof already exists outside it.

log.msg: Live-tile proof (owner's follow-up, relayed via cross-session message): headless Playwright against /framework/ai/dashboard/, with page.route() intercepting GET tasks.json (the real file still doesn't exist in this environment, confirmed by the 404 both tiles show before this test) and fulfilling it with two fake rows (one stalled, one building) only AFTER first paint. AFTER: Stalled shows 'A fake stalled task · minion-fake · quiet 3h' with a ~24% bar (1.2/5 budget); In-flight shows 'A fake building task · minion-fake-2' with a ~40% bar (4/10 budget) — both tiles redrew themselves in place from the poll, not the first paint. Screenshot: shots-live-proof/stalled-inflight-after-poll.png. Script: used a Playwright route fake since the real tasks.json genuinely doesn't exist yet on this machine (stalled-and-budgets hasn't shipped it) — stating this plainly per the ask, not skipping the check.
